resolved_checks.name: local_HEAD_before_new_batch
resolved_checks.evidence: Before staging pending-null branch, rev-parse HEAD must equal state.expected_remote.

resolved_checks.name: pending_HEAD_and_fixed_push_OID
resolved_checks.evidence: Before push, HEAD must equal pending.commit; push source is pending.commit:refs/heads/main, not mutable HEAD.

resolved_checks.name: remote_accepted_state_not_saved_resume
resolved_checks.evidence: If remote main already equals pending.commit, require local HEAD match, mark that pending batch completed and save, then continue.

resolved_checks.name: postcommit_path_and_blob_revalidation
resolved_checks.evidence: diff-tree committed path set must equal exact plan; ls-tree modes/types/blob OIDs must equal SHA1 of original verified bytes.

resolved_checks.name: plan_SHA_and_no_force
resolved_checks.evidence: Resume binds plan SHA; remote tip equality required; push uses no force flag.

resolved_checks.name: exact_staged_scope_and_batchbytes
resolved_checks.evidence: Cached path set equals planned files; every blob SHA256/size and index SHA1 validated; perbatch bytes <=512MiB.

limitations: Static source review only. No actual repository state, remote authentication, Git hooks, staging, commit or push executed by reviewer. Root separately validates actual sealed manifest and repository state.
Failure after commit but before pending state is durably saved still fails closed on next attempt via local HEAD mismatch; root must inspect and reconcile rather than silently re-commit.
